title: Goety DarGui
description: ADD a visual GUI for the Dark Altar, with JEI one-click recipe fill and RS/BD storage network auto-extraction support
body:
Add an intuitive visual graphical user interface (GUI) for the Dark Altar. The GUI clearly displays the altar’s internal item storage slots, allowing players to see at a glance which materials have already been placed. With deep integration with JEI (Just Enough Items), players can click a single fill button while viewing any recipe to automatically distribute the required items into the corresponding slots of the altar, completely eliminating the tedious manual searching and placement.

In addition, this feature fully supports mainstream storage network systems, including Refined Storage (RS) and the Beyond Dimension (BD) storage network, enabling automatic retrieval of all required crafting materials from the network. Once a recipe is selected, the system scans the network inventory in real time, extracts the exact quantities of each item, and transfers them directly to the altar—without any manual preparation from the player. The GUI also provides clear operational feedback, such as warning messages when materials are insufficient, success notifications upon recipe completion, and real‑time network status indicators, ensuring that players can complete every altar crafting session efficiently and error‑free, greatly enhancing the overall user experience.


为黑暗祭坛添加可视化GUI界面，支持JEI一键配方填入，兼容RS/BD存储网络自动提取物品
